data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Flurry Analytics SDK, supporting messaging and remote configuration.
data.what_it_does: Provides integration with the Flurry Analytics SDK for Flutter apps on Android and iOS. It allows tracking events, user properties, crash reporting, remote configuration, and push messaging.
use_when: You need to integrate Flurry Analytics into your Flutter application
You want to use Flurry Push messaging and remote configuration features
avoid_when: You prefer alternative analytics platforms like Firebase Analytics
You are building exclusively for unsupported platforms
strengths: Supports multiple Flurry features including analytics, config, push, and publisher segmentation
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration steps on both Android and iOS
Flurry Messaging and Config are not available on tvOS
data.setup_notes: Requires native setup for Android and iOS, including adding API keys, configuring Gradle/CocoaPods, and optional Firebase setup for push notifications.
